My teaching interests align with wireless communications, communication networks, signal processing, optimization, and machine learning for communication systems. For faculty applications, I would like this page to present both course readiness and a coherent teaching philosophy.

## Teaching philosophy

I aim to help students connect mathematical foundations with practical communication systems. In courses related to wireless networks and signal processing, I emphasize three layers of learning: conceptual understanding, analytical modeling, and implementation-oriented thinking. This structure helps students move from equations and protocols to system-level design decisions.
